newsitem.title: UK: Sears to demerge Selfridges store - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sears to demerge Selfridges store - paper.

text.p: British retailing conglomerate Sears Plc will announce the demerger of its Selfridges departmental store business and the departure of its chief executive Liam Strong, the Times newspaper said on Tuesday.

The group will announce its restructuring plans along with its results for the year to January 1997 on Tuesday, and would report a dip in profit to less than 80 million stg from 100 million in the previous year, the newspaper said.
The paper said Strong would leave the group in June and was likely to be replaced by an outsider.
Analysts had recently speculated a shake-up for Sears as a last resort to bolster its share price which have languished in recent months.

The Times said the group would not make an immediate exit from its loss-making shoe chains. The group will, however, press ahead with the sale of its mail order arm Freemans to Littlewoods, but at a significant lower price than the 395 million stg previously agreed.
